title: 'Tic-tac' leaves as soon as he heads for the helicopter

tellings.quote: I take 10 steps, and " "Tic-tac" begins to fly away.

plain: In 2025, on a hill used as a field site by Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call UFOs to appear, a "Tic-tac", a white oval object shaped like the mint, was hovering nearby. A witness from Skywatcher tells Michels that the moment he started walking toward a helicopter, the object left: "I take 10 steps, and 'Tic-tac' begins to fly away." To him it seemed to react to what he was doing, which would mean it was watching them.
